mapper.select: select m.menu_id as "menuId", m.parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", m.menu_type as "menuType", m.menu_name as "menuName", coalesce(mei.screen_id, m.screen_id) as "screenId", coalesce(mei.url, m.url) as "url", coalesce(mei.icon, m.icon) as "icon", coalesce(mei.business_category, m.business_category) as "businessCategory", coalesce(mei.description, m.description) as "description", m.status as "status", m.change_reason as "changeReason", m.updated_by as "updatedBy", greatest(m.updated_at, coalesce(mei.updated_at, m.updated_at)) as "updatedAt" from menus m left join menu_execution_info mei on mei.menu_id = m.menu_id and mei.status = 'ACTIVE' where m.menu_id = #{menuId} and m.status != 'DELETED'
select count(*) from menus where menu_id = #{menuId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: update menus set menu_name = #{menuName}, screen_id = #{screenId}, url = #{url}, icon = #{icon}, business_category = #{businessCategory}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: insert into menu_execution_info (menu_id, screen_id, url, icon, business_category, description, updated_by, status) values (#{menuId}, #{screenId}, #{url}, #{icon}, #{businessCategory}, #{description}, #{updatedBy}, 'ACTIVE') on conflict (menu_id) do update set screen_id = EXCLUDED.screen_id, url = EXCLUDED.url, icon = EXCLUDED.icon, business_category = EXCLUDED.business_category, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, status = 'ACTIVE'
